exposure: C-Section group vs non C-Section group
Women with bipolar disorder who did not undergo cesarean section
Women with bipolar disorder who underwent cesarean section
finding: In women with bipolar disorder, psychopharmacology and thyroid function might help understanding which women will have a higher probability of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with bipolar disorder who were treated with lithium plus antidepressants, had hypothyroidism, and did not experience obstetric complications had a 70.5% probability of cesarean section.
